item.title: Dangerous hedges that could blind someone, 20th September
item.description:
End of Northern Wellington Lane dead end, last street light is obstructed by hedge which is growing out of the highway and obstructing the road and narrowing turning and parking area. Thorny bush that is dangerous and caused injury to my young son on his bicycle. We took our son here to teach him to ride his bicycle on the road as it is a quiet no-through road. There were two cars and a van parked almost opposite each other and only leaving a narrow space with a dangerous prickly bush growing out of control and out of the tarmac of the road. He was hit in the face and down one side of his body, arms and legs by this dangerous over grown bush and was in pain and left with deep scratches across his face and body. The road should not have been allowed to be narrowed like this and we can see so many dangers with the situation. Visability, parking and turning are restricted and the vegetation is out of control and dangerous as it is covered in sharp thorns. It has been allowed to grow up the street light and is obstructing the light as well. I am just thankful that he wasn’t caught in the eye by the spikes from this hedge. It is at eye level for children and adults of all heights.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Wellington Lane, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.description:

Tree is significantly more overhanging into private property at 181 than in rest of the road due to the property being a corner plot and being at the apex of bend in road. I tried reporting this last year but technical faults with the site prevented it, though I did lodge a dangerous tree email report with Sam Reader @ Cheltenham Borough Council at the time.

item.title: Unauthorized / Incorrect Road Closure, 20th September
item.description:
Unauthorized / Incorrect Road Closure (9:00 AM): This morning, Evesham Road Hyde Lane and Southam Lane Junction was entirely closed off with a diversion sign placed directly at the traffic lights. Because of this incorrect closure, I was forced to turn into oncoming traffic at 9:00 AM just to safely access my place of work, creating a severe and unacceptable safety hazard. Conflicting & Negligent Signage: The signage displayed at the intersection was entirely contradictory. Signs stated both "Road ahead closed access only", "Cheltenham half marathon green car park ONLY" and "DIVERSION". At no point did any signage indicate that local businesses on Evesham Road were open as usual, turning away crucial Sunday trading footfall. Public Interference & Self-Correction (10:30 AM): Due to the lack of clear management or marshal presence at this position, a member of the public moved the diversion sign at 10:30 AM to allow access. To protect oncoming drivers and ensure cars could turn into the road safely, I had to personally lay the misleading diversion sign flat and relocate the remaining signs. I have attached a picture I took before moving the signs. Please note that whilst I was approaching the junction, there was nearly a collision where a driver had braked suddenly, seemingly confused over the directions. The placement of these signs represents a severe lack of oversight by the event organisers and the Council's highway licensing team. It actively choked off trade for an open business while forcing drivers into dangerous manoeuvres.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Evesham Road, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
